text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Actuellement, la politique environnementale évolue dans un contexte plus global: le Conseil fédéral veut encourager un usage plus parcimonieux des ressources naturelles de la planète.", "gist": "Swiss environmental policy is now evolving in a more global context, with the Federal Council aiming to promote more frugal use of the planet's natural resources."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La politique environnementale a depuis longtemps une portée internationale.", "gist": "Environmental policy has long had an international scope."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Suisse", "gist": "Switzerland"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Au niveau bilatéral", "gist": "At the bilateral level"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "certains pays", "gist": "certain countries"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle coopère ainsi depuis plusieurs années avec la Chine dans le domaine de la prévention des crues.", "gist": "Switzerland has been cooperating with China for several years in flood prevention."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Initiative pour la responsabilité environnementale", "gist": "Environmental Responsibility Initiative"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "9 février 2025", "gist": "February 9, 2025"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le 9 février 2025, le peuple a rejeté l’initiative pour la responsabilité environnementale.", "gist": "On February 9, 2025, the people rejected the Environmental Responsibility Initiative."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L’acceptation aurait eu des conséquences négatives importantes pour la population et l’économie.", "gist": "Acceptance would have had significant negative consequences for the population and the economy."}]}
